baseline_reproduction.method: A detached git worktree was created at the pre-M1 commit and the registered baseline suite was run there independently, so the comparison is against a real run rather than against a remembered number.

extra_failure_adjudication.claim: The one extra failure is an order-dependent flake in the full-suite run, not a regression introduced by Study 4F-M1.

evidence.run: the extra node alone at M1 HEAD
the extra node alone at the pre-M1 baseline
the whole module tests/test_study2_stage_bd.py at the pre-M1 baseline
the whole module tests/test_study2_stage_bd.py at M1 HEAD

extra_failure_adjudication.conclusion: The node passes deterministically at both commits when run alone and when its whole module is run. It fails only inside the full-suite run, and it is not in the registered nine. M1 changed no byte that this module reads: every M1 path is additive and lives under studies/study4f/execution-m1/ plus the single M1 authority file under studies/study4f/prompts/.

study4f_namespace_suites.expiry_rationale: Each of these assertions enumerates the paths its own study may have added and compares them against a git diff that ends at HEAD. Publishing the M1 authority at studies/study4f/prompts/study4f_m1_mooncake_four_a100_execution_authority.md, and the M1 records under studies/study4f/execution-m1/, necessarily adds paths outside those enumerations. The modules are protected historical bytes that section 9 of the M1 authority forbids editing, so no publication of M1 leaves them passing and no repair avoids changing a protected byte. This is exactly the expiry mechanism already recorded for Study 4F, E1 and Q1, and the failures are recorded rather than repaired or suppressed.
study4f_namespace_suites.reason_outside_baseline: pyproject sets testpaths = ["tests"], so these modules are not part of the registered repository baseline and the nine standing failure node IDs are unaffected.

design_statistics_reproduction.note: The protocol records each size and power as a compact rational approximation, while the instrument returns the unreduced exact Fraction. The two agree to within 1e-12 on every one of the four quantities, and both pass boundaries recompute exactly. No threshold, alpha, boundary or cell count was changed.

conclusion.statement: Existing Study 4F instrument, statistics, state-machine and protected-byte validation all pass. The registered repository baseline reproduces exactly at the pre-M1 commit, the nine registered failure node IDs are unchanged, the one extra full-suite failure is a demonstrated order-dependent flake present independently of M1, and the four namespace failures are the same scope-predicate expiry mechanism already recorded for Study 4F, E1 and Q1.
